description: This file defines the class ViewSugarFieldCollection, which manages the behavior of collection fields within the SuiteCRM application. It handles setup, retrieval of related data, template rendering, and JavaScript generation for collections in the user interface.

classes.name: ViewSugarFieldCollection
classes.description: Class responsible for handling collection-type custom fields in SuiteCRM, including setup, data retrieval, rendering, and JavaScript generation for collection fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection field object, decoding display parameters and vardefs from the request, and setting up template paths.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Establishes the relationship with the related module, loads the bean, and retrieves related collection data.

methods.name: retrieve_values
methods.description: Fetches related records from the database and organizes them into the bean's properties.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Delegates processing based on action type ('editview' or 'detailview').

methods.name: process_detailview
methods.description: Placeholder for processing detail view; currently empty.

methods.name: process_editview
methods.description: Prepares display parameters, loads related field definitions, and sets up frontend display configuration.

methods.name: init_tpl
methods.description: Initializes the Smarty template engine with data for rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML output for the collection field, caching templates as needed.

methods.name: checkTemplate
methods.description: Checks whether a cached template exists and is up-to-date.

methods.name: createQuickSearchCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code or data structures for quick search functionality within collection fields.

methods.name: createPopupCode
methods.description: Sets up the data required for the popup selection dialogs related to collection fields.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Locates the appropriate Smarty template file for rendering, considering language and custom overrides.
